title: IndexedDB Multi-Tab Versionchange Handshake
description: Trace how Tab 1 releases its v1 handle via onversionchange so Tab 2 can run the v2 migration without blocking.

steps.label: 1. Tab 2 Requests Schema v2
steps.description: Newly deployed Tab 2 calls indexedDB.open('app-db', 2) while Tab 1 still holds a v1 connection.
steps.codeHighlight: const req = indexedDB.open('app-db', 2); // blocked until Tab 1 closes

steps.label: 2. Tab 1 Handles onversionchange
steps.description: Engine dispatches versionchange to Tab 1; Tab 1 calls db.close() and pauses writes.

steps.label: 3. Atomic v1 -> v2 Upgrade Commits
steps.description: Tab 2 executes onupgradeneeded synchronously, creates the new index, and resolves onsuccess.
